input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) sets a 1-year initial term with automatic renewal for successive one-year (not multi-year) periods, and either party — including us — may prevent renewal on written notice given only 30 days before the end of the term. That is a 12-month renewal term with a 30-day non-renewal window, which meets the preferred position and is well inside both the fallback (≤60 days) and walk-away (>90 days / multi-year) thresholds. Section 14 (p0079) additionally lets Client exit on notice effective the last day of the following month, further easing exit in our favour. Two preferred sub-elements are absent but are minor and not redlined: there is no Vendor obligation to send a renewal reminder 60 days out, and no express cap on renewal price increases — Section 6 (p0047) only freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds a most-favoured-rate commitment, so uplift on later renewals is uncapped. We would raise the reminder and a CPI/3% uplift cap as drafting asks if the agreement is reopened, but neither failure is material under this rule.
